mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 20, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Al Jazeera cameraman Ahmed Wishah killed in Israeli strike on Gaza. Multiple outlets reported that Ahmed Wishah, a cameraman for Al Jazeera, was killed in an Israeli strike on a house in the Bureij refugee camp in central Gaza. Al Jazeera said Wishah was among at least 260 Palestinian journalists killed since Israel's war on Gaza began in October 2023. This was reported by The Guardian, Al Jazeera, and BBC News. 2. Parents and two daughters killed in Israeli strike in Gaza. Israel has repeatedly violated the October ceasefire brokered by the US. This was reported by Al Jazeera.
